metadata.method: Arithmetic mean of the longitude and latitude of live England postcode-unit centroids within every outward postcode district with live England postcodes.
metadata.limitation: Each coordinate is a postcode-district reference point. It is not a district boundary, patient location, or exact GP-practice coordinate.
